''See also: [[Fate Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Fate is a fundamental force in the world that represents a direction or tendency for events to occur, rather than being synonymous with the future itself. It is often described as a collection of possible paths or strands, where some outcomes are more likely than others. While fate provides a most probable trajectory for a life or a world, it is not absolute; destiny can be altered by intervention, chaos, or the specific intentions of individuals. Consequently, what is destined to happen does not always come to pass. Various powerful entities and specialized groups interact with this force. Certain individuals, such as the [[Abidan Judges]] or specific [[Monarchs]], possess the ability to see, read, or even manipulate the flow of fate. For example, some can observe potential futures as branching paths or threads, while others, like the [[Hound Division]], work to steer causality and manage these possibilities. However, reading fate is considered an art rather than a precise science, as it can be obscured by chaos, corrupted by powerful presences, or hidden by those with significant strength. While most natural cause and effect should not change the flow of fate, certain extraordinary beings or events can disrupt it, causing the established paths to shift or dissolve.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Elder Whisper]] occasionally experiences glimpses of Fate within his [[dreams]]. During his travels, [[Eithan]] identifies the concept as a potential explanation for the sensations he is experiencing, though he soon detects a significant disruption in its flow. While [[Makiel]] contends that any attempt to save the world would constitute a deviation from this path, [[Eithan]] eventually gains the ability to see and arrange Fate itself.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Eithan]] identifies [[Fate|fate]] as a possibility for what he is sensing.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c8">''Reaper'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Makiel]] argued that saving the world would be a deviation from [[Fate]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Fate is a fundamental concept that governs the destiny and various branches of worlds. These branches consist of flows that possess the ability to dissolve, and they bend in response to the actions taken by Ozriel. While intentions can influence these flows, [[Daruman]] maintains the ability to twist them. Additionally, [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]] can scan Fate in order to read upcoming events.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|During the unfolding events, Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel's runic eyes were able to perceive Fate as it was being woven. This essence was observed by [[Makiel]], who witnessed the force split and twist. When the [[Penance arrow]] thundered through space, it also tore through Fate itself. The [[oracle codex]] was used to check the state of Fate, revealing its true flow. Finally, [[Malice]] gazed into the shadows cast by Fate.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Fate is a phenomenon that can be physically touched through [[Way|the Way]]. It offers projections of future events, which even [[Dross]] is capable of glimpsing. However, reading these projections can result in inaccuracies. Currently, Fate has not yet stabilized, and the [[OTEP]] possesses no greater access to it than any other [[Presence]].}}
